metadata.name: 暖色物质 (Material Warmth)
metadata.author: xyzckl
metadata.description: 基于 Material You 风格，采用温暖的橙色系色彩提取与大圆角设计，为数字空间注入温度。

assets.css: /* 背景接管：使用温暖的橙色渐变，并确保优先级 */ body { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff7ed 0%, #ffedd5 100%) !important; background-attachment: fixed !important; } /* 隐藏原生背景层 */ #xyz-bg-layer { display: none !important; } /* Material You 风格卡片定制 */ .xyz-hover-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) !important; border-radius: 24px !important; /* 经典大圆角 */ border: 1px solid rgba(255, 165, 0, 0.2) !important; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.1) !important; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) !important; } /* 悬浮交互增强 */ .xyz-hover-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.02); border-color: rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.5) !important; } /* 文字颜色优化 */ h1, h2, p { color: #7c2d12 !important; /* 深焦糖色，增加阅读舒适度 */ }
assets.html: 暖色模式已激活 🧡
assets.js: // 主题加载后的初始化逻辑 console.info('Material Warmth Theme: 正在应用色彩提取逻辑...'); window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { const bar = document.getElementById('theme-welcome-bar'); if (bar) { // 3秒后淡出欢迎挂件 setTimeout(() => { bar.style.transition = 'opacity 1s ease'; bar.style.opacity = '0'; setTimeout(() => bar.remove(), 1000); }, 3000); } });
